title: BN10 two-key related-key boomerang key recovery on7-round AES-128

target.description: Source Figure4 seven-round AES-128 interval:3-round single-key top component, related-key bottom component and one extra bottom round. Section3.2 gives voting and an about2^96 exhaustive completion or shifted repeat.

setting.key_relation: Two related secret master keys defined through the prescribed XOR difference at K4/K7 and the standard invertible AES-128 key schedule; the source explicitly uses two, not four keys.
setting.plaintext_model: 2^66 chosen plaintexts and 2^97 adaptive chosen ciphertexts, with 31-bit guesses controlling the second-key inverse queries.

time.note: Table1 headline2^97 is retained. Section3.2 separately adds about2^96 completion; the formal sum has log2≈97.585 only if these native steps are treated as the same unit, which is not a replacement reported estimate.

data.note: Section 3.2 separates directions; Table 1 headline 2^97 does not replace the full query vector.

memory.note: The source does not separately quantify this resource for this configuration.

preprocessing.note: No separate setup budget is stated.

success.description: Section3.2 requests two good quartets under the correct31-bit bottom-key guess, estimates false-quartet counts and expects none to survive the91-bit vote. No trial-denominated or numerical complete-key success is given. All local values below use the source correct-guess/compatibility model; the two bottom branches are not blindly treated as independent copies of2^-30.

review.scope: Targeted exact-edition success audit of defining construction and parameter passages, not a new full-paper or forward-literature audit. Source local/conditional models, expected counts, key-relation construction and full recovery remain separate.
